Flutter Server Box

A Flutter+Rust project which provides charts to display Linux, Unix and Windows server status and tools to manage servers.
Read the documentation site for user guides, architecture notes, and development instructions.

## Acknowledgements Special thanks to dartssh2 & xterm.dart. Thanks to my partner for their emotional and financial support. Thanks to OpenAI for providing six months of ChatGPT Pro 20x subscription. ## Screenshots
8 more screenshots
## Installation | Platform | Download | | --- | --- | | iOS | [AppStore](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1586449703) / [GitHub](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box/releases) (`_NoSign.ipa`, unsigned, you need to sign it yourself) | | macOS | [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1586449703) (Apple silicon only) / [GitHub](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box/releases) (architecture-specific `.dmg`) / `brew install --cask server-box` | | Android | [GitHub](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box/releases) / [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/tech.lolli.toolbox) / [OpenAPK](https://www.openapk.net/serverbox/tech.lolli.toolbox/) | | Linux / Windows | [GitHub](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box/releases) | Download packages only from sources you trust. ## Features **Connecting** - Connect directly over SSH, through a jump host or with a `ProxyCommand`. You can also connect over HTTP through the [Monitor](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/advanced/monitor-agent/) when you do not want to expose a host's SSH port. A server can use both methods, with automatic fallback if one is unavailable. - Open a shell on this device or install a Linux userland ([local terminal](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/advanced/local-terminal/)) on supported platforms. **Watching** - Live and historical charts for CPU, memory, swap, disks, disk I/O and network, plus sensors, GPUs (NVIDIA, AMD), batteries and disk S.M.A.R.T. - See all servers at a glance, filter them by tag or view them on a [globe](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/advanced/globe/). - Push alerts, [home-screen widgets](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/advanced/widgets/) and a watchOS app. The Monitor keeps these features working while the app is closed. **Working on a server** - A full terminal with virtual keys on phones, plus a [workspace](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/advanced/workspace/) with split panes that can send input to several terminals at once. - Browse, upload, download and edit files over SFTP or SCP. Markdown files open in a rendered preview. - [RDP and VNC](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/advanced/remote-desktop/), to the server itself or to a desktop it can reach. - Docker and Podman, processes, systemd services, users and groups, firewall rules (ufw, firewalld), scheduled tasks, port forwards and snippets. - Virtual machines and containers on libvirt and Proxmox VE, and a server's BMC over Redfish ([BMC](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/advanced/bmc/)). - Benchmarks (YABS) and iperf. - An [AI Agent](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/advanced/agent/) that works with your servers and the model providers, MCP servers and skills you choose. **Making it yours** - Install [themes and icon packs](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/advanced/theme-packages/) from the built-in store, or make your own. - Biometric app lock, and backups to iCloud or WebDAV, encrypted with a password you choose. - iOS, Android, macOS, Linux and Windows, in 17 languages. ## Help - [ServerBox Monitor](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box/tree/main/monitor) is a component you install on your servers. It is required for features that need to work while the app is closed — **push notifications**, **home-screen widgets**, and the **watch app**. It also offers another way to add a server: the app can connect to it over HTTP instead of SSH, which suits hosts whose SSH port you prefer not to expose, and gives charts historical data from before the app's first connection. Monitor also serves its own web panel. - **Agent skills:** This repository includes three skills for AI agents. Add them with ```sh npx skills add lollipopkit/flutter_server_box ``` - [`serverbox-help`](.claude/skills/serverbox-help): using the app and deploying and configuring the Monitor — adding servers, why a feature is missing for a server, permissions, alerts, widgets, backups. The app's own Agent ships with it. - [`serverbox-onboarding`](.claude/skills/serverbox-onboarding): working on the code — setting up the Flutter + Rust + Node environment, building and testing, and how the project works. - [`serverbox-theme`](.claude/skills/serverbox-theme): making a theme package (`.fsbt`), validating it and publishing it to the theme store. Their source is in this repository, so you can read what they will tell your Monitor before installing them. Before opening an issue, please: 1. Use the bug report template. 2. Confirm that the issue is caused by ServerBox. 3. Concrete, constructive feedback is welcome. Subjective requests, such as preferring another UI, may not be accepted. ## Contributions [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) covers the development setup, the commit convention, the checks to run, and how translations work. Contributors sign the [CLA](CLA.md) once by leaving a comment on their first pull request. It grants the right to ship your work in App Store builds alongside the AGPLv3 source. You retain the copyright to your work. If I forgot to add your name to the contributors list, please add a comment in the issue or PR you opened to let me know, I will add it as soon as possible. ## My other apps - [LLMBox](https://github.com/lollipopkit/llmbox): a third-party client for the OpenAI API. - [MFuse](https://mfuse.lollipopkit.com): mounts SFTP, S3, WebDAV and more in macOS Finder through File Provider. ## License `AGPL v3 lollipopkit & all contributors`

Flutter Server Box

使用 Flutter+Rust 开发的 Linux, Unix, Windows 服务器工具箱，提供服务器状态图表和管理工具。
用户指南、架构说明和开发文档请参阅文档站。

## 致谢 特别感谢 dartssh2 & xterm.dart。 感谢我的对象提供的 精神+经济 支持。 感谢 OpenAI 赠送的六个月 ChatGPT Pro 20x 订阅。 ## 截屏
另外 8 张
## 安装 | 平台 | 下载 | | --- | --- | | iOS | [AppStore](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1586449703) / [GitHub](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box/releases)（`_NoSign.ipa`，未签名，需自行签名后安装） | | macOS | [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1586449703)（仅支持 Apple silicon） / [GitHub](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box/releases)（按架构分别提供 `.dmg`） / `brew install --cask server-box` | | Android | [GitHub](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box/releases) / [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/tech.lolli.toolbox) / [OpenAPK](https://www.openapk.net/serverbox/tech.lolli.toolbox/) | | Linux / Windows | [GitHub](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box/releases) | 请只从可信来源下载。 ## 特点 **连接** - 支持 SSH 直连、经跳板机连接或使用 `ProxyCommand`；也可通过 [Monitor](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/zh/advanced/monitor-agent/) 使用 HTTP 连接，适用于不希望暴露 SSH 端口的主机。 - 在支持的平台上，可打开本机 shell，或安装 Linux 用户空间（[本机终端](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/zh/advanced/local-terminal/)）。 **查看状态** - CPU、内存、交换分区、磁盘、磁盘 I/O 和网络的实时与历史图表，以及传感器、GPU（NVIDIA、AMD）、电池和磁盘 S.M.A.R.T.。 - 一览所有服务器，可按标签筛选，也可在[地球视图](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/zh/advanced/globe/)中查看。 - 推送提醒、[桌面小组件](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/zh/advanced/widgets/)和 watchOS App；App 关闭后，Monitor 仍会为这些功能提供支持。 **管理服务器** - 完整的终端；[工作区](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/zh/advanced/workspace/)支持分屏。 - 通过 SFTP 或 SCP 浏览、上传、下载并直接编辑文件。 - [RDP 和 VNC](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/zh/advanced/remote-desktop/)，可以连服务器本身，也可以连它能访问到的其他桌面。 - Docker 与 Podman、进程、systemd 服务、用户与用户组、防火墙规则（ufw、firewalld）、定时任务、端口转发和代码片段。 - 管理 libvirt 和 Proxmox VE 上的虚拟机与容器，通过 Redfish 管理服务器的 [BMC](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/zh/advanced/bmc/)。 - 基准测试（YABS）和 iperf。 - [AI Agent](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/zh/advanced/agent/) 可协助管理服务器，并使用你选择的模型提供商、MCP server 和 skill。 **个性化** - 内置商店里的[主题和图标包](https://serverbox.lollipopkit.com/docs/zh/advanced/theme-packages/)，也可以自己制作。 - 生物识别应用锁；可将备份保存到 iCloud 或 WebDAV，并使用你设置的密码加密。 - 支持 iOS、Android、macOS、Linux 和 Windows，16 种语言。 ## 帮助 - [ServerBox Monitor](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box/tree/main/monitor) 是安装在你服务器上的服务端组件。不打开 ServerBox app 时仍需工作的功能都依赖它 —— **推送通知**、**桌面小部件** 和 **手表 app**；它同时也是添加服务器的第二种方式：app 可以经 HTTP 而不是 SSH 访问它，适用于不便暴露 SSH 端口的主机，并且图表在 app 首次连接前就已有历史数据。Monitor 还提供网页面板。 - **Agent skills：** 本仓库包含三份供 AI agent 使用的 skill。使用下面的命令添加： ```sh npx skills add lollipopkit/flutter_server_box ``` - [`serverbox-help`](.claude/skills/serverbox-help)：使用 App，以及部署和配置 Monitor，例如添加服务器、某台服务器缺少某个功能的原因、权限、告警、小部件和备份。App 内置的 Agent 自带这份 skill。 - [`serverbox-onboarding`](.claude/skills/serverbox-onboarding)：参与开发，包括搭建 Flutter + Rust + Node 开发环境、构建与测试，以及项目的工作原理。 - [`serverbox-theme`](.claude/skills/serverbox-theme)：制作主题包（`.fsbt`），校验后发布到主题商店。 它们的源文件都在本仓库中，安装前可以先读一读它们会告诉你的 Monitor 什么。 提交 issue 前请确认： 1. 使用 bug 报告模板提交。 2. 确认问题确实由 ServerBox 引起。 3. 欢迎具体、建设性的反馈。主观偏好，例如更喜欢其他 UI，可能不会被采纳。 ## 贡献 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 说明了开发环境、commit 规范、提交前要跑的检查，以及翻译流程。 贡献者需要签署一次 [CLA](CLA_zh.md)（[英文原文](CLA.md)，以英文为准）：在你的第一个 PR 下留一条评论即可。它授予的权利使你的工作可以随 App Store 版本一起发布，同时源码保持 AGPLv3——你自己的版权仍然属于你。 如果我忘记在贡献者列表中添加你的名字，请在你打开的 issue 或 PR 中添加评论让我知道，我会尽快添加。 ## 我的其他 App - [LLMBox](https://github.com/lollipopkit/llmbox)：OpenAI API 的第三方客户端。 - [MFuse](https://mfuse.lollipopkit.com)：通过 File Provider 把 SFTP、S3、WebDAV 等挂载到 macOS 访达。 ## 证书 `AGPL v3 lollipopkit & 所有贡献者`
